name: Untitled
purpose: Second icon exploration; awaiting user selection

variants.label: A · Unfold / 展开
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create an original, beautifully art-directed macOS application icon concept for a brand called Untitled: software that people continually shape through their own agent-built plugins. The brand should feel independent, thoughtful, expressive, open to possibility.
The user rejected generic circles with gaps, squares with detached pieces, letter U monograms, underscores and simple geometric assembly exercises. Explore a distinctive graphic identity with memorable character and optical sophistication.
Visual style: pure black and white only; striking flat 2D editorial graphic design; meticulous silhouette; rich use of negative space; bold enough to read at Dock size; restrained and confident.
Presentation: one final icon, square 1024x1024 image, centered on a solid white background that extends to every edge. The mark occupies about 60 percent of the square. No mockup or surrounding scene, no contact sheet, no captions or lettering.
Avoid: houses, rooftops, doors, nests, domestic metaphors, generic software symbols, detached accent squares, crop marks, code brackets, cursor, underscore, letter U, power icon, infinity icon, hexagonal AI knots, stars or sparkles, robots, gears. Absolutely no color, gray shading, gradients, shadows, texture, paper grain, glass, bevels, depth or 3D. All visual interest must come from the form itself.
Creative direction: an expressive continuous black sculptural ribbon, folded and opened into an asymmetrical compact emblem. It should look like a single ingenious gesture that keeps unfolding, with one broad flowing bend, one crisp cut, and an unusual generous white aperture. Mix taut straight edges with an elegant organic curve. Visually intriguing but with very few elements. Do not draw paper, a page, a common knot, a letter, an arrow, or a cube. Aim for a mark a great independent design studio would make, rather than an illustrative folded object.
